part3_diagnosis.exact_cause: src/acquisition/b2n_qualification.py B2NExecutor.run() line 249: `if response.outcome != OUTCOME_SUCCESS or not response.evidence_observed or not response.provenance_complete: break`. MigrationGetTransactionAdapter (src/acquisition/b2w_projection.py), the B2N-native migration-lineage-only adapter qualified in P3B, ALWAYS returns evidence_observed=False on every successful call (it never claims creator-funding evidence, by design -- see error_class=B2W_MIGRATION_LINEAGE_ONLY). Therefore `not response.evidence_observed` is unconditionally True for every member, so the loop breaks after exactly one member on EVERY invocation, regardless of HTTP outcome, regardless of which member is processed first.
ruled_out_by_direct_inspection: no premature return statement inside the per-member loop
no indentation error -- the break is correctly scoped inside the for loop, at the expected place
not an iterator exhaustion bug -- for member in self.manifest.members correctly iterates all 20 manifest members; the loop CAN reach member 2..20, it chooses to stop via the explicit break condition
not a ledger duplicate/empty-semantics bug -- B2NAttemptLedger.require_empty() only runs once, at the start of run(), not per-member

not client state preventing the second member -- DurableAccountingClient has no internal state that would reject a second acquire_once() call for a DIFFERENT ordinal (verified: duplicate-ordinal rejection only triggers for the SAME ordinal, per P3E test_max_one_attempted_request_per_member)

not an authorization request-budget bug -- max_physical_requests=20 is correctly read and total_requests(1) < 20 at the point the loop would otherwise continue to member 2; the break happens for a DIFFERENT reason (evidence_observed check), not a budget check

the migration-lineage-only error_class (B2W_MIGRATION_LINEAGE_ONLY) IS being correctly interpreted as a non-qualifying outcome by the existing, already-qualified stop condition -- this is the actual mechanism, confirmed by code read and reproduced with a mocked ALWAYS-SUCCESSFUL transport (see reproduction below)

reproduction_with_always_successful_tran.method: constructed a fake transport that would return a valid SUCCESS response for all 20 members if asked, wired through the real DurableAccountingClient/MigrationGetTransactionAdapter/B2NExecutor stack, zero network calls
reproduction_with_always_successful_tran.result: executor.run() still returns exactly 1 result and the transport's physical_request_count is exactly 1 -- proving the loop stops after member 1 purely due to evidence_observed=False, not due to any transport/network failure
reproduction_with_always_successful_tran.conclusion: this would have happened identically even if the live Helius call for every one of the 20 members had succeeded perfectly -- it is a structural property of the current B2NExecutor + MigrationGetTransactionAdapter pairing, not a live-environment defect

part3_diagnosis.architectural_root: B2NExecutor's stop-on-non-qualifying-outcome condition was designed with a creator-funding-evidence use case in mind (matching B2Z's semantics, where evidence_observed=True is a genuine, achievable success signal). The P3B reconciliation correctly narrowed B2N's PURPOSE to migration-lineage-only, but did not (until this milestone) trace that this narrowing makes evidence_observed permanently False for B2N specifically -- which, combined with the SHARED executor's stop condition, limits any single B2NExecutor.run() invocation to exactly one processed member for this adapter.

part4_fix_decision.reasoning: B2NExecutor.run()'s stop condition is NOT modified, because it is shared, already-qualified code also relied upon by (or architecturally analogous to) creator-funding-evidence contracts where evidence_observed=True is a meaningful success signal and stopping on the first non-qualifying outcome is a genuine safety property, not a defect. Weakening or bypassing that condition specifically for B2N risks silently changing behavior other contracts may depend on. Instead, a continuation contract is qualified at the P3C/P3E RUNNER level (scripts/run_b2n_p3c_migration_lineage_run.py), which repeatedly and safely invokes B2NExecutor.run() -- once per remaining member -- while durably tracking completed ordinals across invocations via the existing event ledger and attempt ledger, neither of which is reset between invocations.
